feeding_claim.verbatim: They are never fed any grain throughout their life.

resold_note: Also buys in grass-fed cattle and sheep from other similarly managed farms.
notes: Run by Tom and Kristi German with son Daniel managing the farm. The site title and meta description still say Holstein, IA, but the about page says the farm is near Laporte City and the contact page gives the Laporte City address, so it appears to have moved; city set to Laporte City. Read the homepage, about, products, why grass-fed and contact pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote, which the products page uses for both beef and lamb). About page: 'We feed our beef cattle and sheep a 100% grass-fed diet' and no grain, grain by-products or oil seed supplements. Pork and hens get certified organic, soy-free feed; chickens free-range on the farmstead. About page also says they 'acquire qualified cattle and sheep from other similarly managed farms' (see resold_note), so not all beef and lamb is home-raised. Contact page lists delivery to Lincoln, Omaha, Western, Central and Eastern Iowa; farm visits by appointment only. The Barn2Door store page was blocked, so bulk shares, pickup points, delivery schedule and any shipping are unconfirmed; no quarter/half/whole found on the farm site. No phone published. Goats, milk and soap appear only in photos/captions, so no dairy listed.
